ci.name: Quality Gate (pre-merge)
ci.when: before a pull request may merge
ci.runs: a selected subset: the smoke set plus gated cases of every journey the PR reaches

cd.name: Release Gate (post-merge)
cd.when: after merge, on the staging environment
cd.runs: regression and key cases of the role

rules: The healer is off inside both gates.
A failed gate stays red until a person decides. The harness never passes a failed gate.
Skips, missing results, zero selected cases and quarantined cases are not passing evidence.
